title: BioactiveCompound
description: Compound / bioactive registry entry. Peptides are a provenance class (where they come from), not only a chemical class. Digestion-generated bioactives attach to host×food edges — same shape as urolithin A conversion.

provenance.description: Tier 1 present as eaten; Tier 2 formed by fermentation/hydrolysis before eating; Tier 3 formed in gut (host×food edge).

attachment.description: Where the claim/score lives. digestion_generated must be host_food_edge.

proline_rich_gate.description: For peptides: proline-rich sequences more likely to survive peptidases into serum (structural plausibility gate, not proof).

evidence_grade.description: Claim grade for this bioactive as scoped by provenance (not marketing copy).

legacy_ids.description: Old taxonomy ids this replaces (e.g. collagen).

process_requirements.description: e.g. fermentation, enzymatic_hydrolysis — required for process_generated scores.
